searchText: I'm probably going to need to either allow passing of more error responses in some places or throw a lot more 500's than i'd like. current example: `/eth/v1/beacon/states/:state_id/validators/:validator_id` allows for 200, 404, 500... parsing state_id and validator_id could produce errors... is everyone just allowing that kind of issue to fall through to a 500? I'm returning 404, but 400 might be better i'll get to a 404 if they parse to numeric then aren't present, but currently they're failing to parse (eg. type `haed` for state) and they go to 500 :/ i guess success conditions are probably more important anyway I'm with <@!545555441518772225> that bad user input should result in a 400. Additional information about the cause of the failure can go in the status text. would the intent then be to change the openapi docs to include possible 400 responses for the endpoints that are missing it? We should have 500 as an option for all endpoints, and 400 fo any endpoint that has input. We’re returning 400s for badly formed requests Are those JSON-RPC requests, or something else? JSON-RPC specification has some very clear wording on how to respond to failures that should be followed if using it. If this is some custom API endpoint, then we can ignore all of that. 🙂 It's a custom endpoint, not JSON-RPC https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/pull/89 adds an explicit 400 response code for all endpoints with input I was going to ask about eventstream, but decided i'd just make the PR of what I think and we can discuss there... https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/pull/90
